delivery_evidence: Primarily Math delivered via two 2-week Summer Institutes (8-hr days, >=80 contact hr each) plus academic-year graduate coursework and on-site math coaches; no online/remote component described (p.143-144 'The Elementary Mathematics Specialist Program' / Table of PD components).
test_alignment_evidence: Sole student outcome is the TEMA-3 (Test of Early Mathematics Ability, 3rd Ed.), a published norm-referenced standardized mathematics test not tailored to the PD content (p.145 measures); test_type=standardized_independent.
curriculum_evidence: PD is an inservice mathematics-specialist program building teachers' content/pedagogical knowledge (MKT), not adoption of a new student curriculum; the district's separate rollout of the 'Math Expressions' curriculum for one cohort is noted as a confound, not part of Primarily Math (p.141 program description; p.150 curriculum-confound note).
outcome_timing_evidence: Outcome is within-year fall-to-spring TEMA-3 growth (MASD) measured during program years 2009-2013; same-school-year measurement, no post-program follow-up wave (p.145-147; extraction timepoint 'fall-spring within-year growth').
